description.name: ISPConfig Connect
description.tagline: Provision and manage ISPConfig 3 hosting accounts from WHMCS.
description.long: ISPConfig Connect provisions ISPConfig 3 clients, websites, FTP users, mail domains, DNS zones and databases over the ISPConfig remote JSON API, and manages the full service lifecycle (suspend, unsuspend, password change, package change, terminate) from WHMCS. It also imports disk and bandwidth usage, publishes nine usage-billing metrics, synchronises accounts from the panel, shows live panel health on the servers page, and offers optional single sign-on through the ispconfig-sso companion.
features: All-or-nothing account provisioning with automatic rollback
Client template and web server dropdowns loaded live from the panel
Nightly disk and bandwidth usage import, and nine usage-billing metrics
Server Sync: compare WHMCS services against the accounts on the panel
Live panel version, node and job-queue health on Configuration > Servers
Optional password-free single sign-on via the ispconfig-sso companion
Actionable Test Connection diagnostics including missing API grants
Every API call logged with credentials masked, and the panel's customer records - bank details, tax id, postal address, 2FA columns - dropped before they reach the log
